# Shared shred first-arrival dedup vectors (BLO-15080). One step per line:
#   <slot> <shred_index> <version> <first|duplicate>
# Steps run in order against ONE fresh deduper. `version` is a small integer
# naming a distinct leader-signed Merkle root of the same shred. Consumers:
#   libmmt  shred-forwarder/src/shred_dedup.rs (tests::shared_first_arrival_vectors)
#   go-amt  cmd/shred-merger/main_test.go     (TestDedupSharedVectors)
# Out of scope (consumer-specific, not shared): v3 unsigned wildcard, retention.
100 5 1 first
100 5 1 duplicate
# reorder: higher index first, lower later, each its own shred
100 9 1 first
100 2 1 first
100 9 1 duplicate
# next slot with the same index is a different shred
101 5 1 first
# version conflict: a second signed root of one shred is a distinct first copy
100 5 2 first
100 5 2 duplicate
100 5 1 duplicate
100 5 3 first
